title_en: 44th Scout Brigade, in time to rescue the people from a snake attack.
summary_en: The 44th Special Task Force, under the command of the 4413rd Brigade, entered into aid to people in the middle of the night at the request of community leaders after being notified that there was a snake smuggled inside the houses of citizens in the area. As soon as they were notified, officials quickly travelled to the area to assist urgently when on site.
